interface.evidence: Original interface lists clk, 8-bit d, and 8-bit q only.

semantics.capture: At each positive edge of clk, q becomes the sampled d after the sequential update.
semantics.hold: q holds its last sampled value between positive edges, including falling edges and input changes.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior is specified; none is added.
semantics.initialization: No initial value is specified; RTL has no initialization. Tests do not demand a defined value before first capture.
semantics.evidence: Original states: include 8 D flip-flops; all DFFs triggered by positive edge of clock.

numeric.mapping: q[i] captures d[i] for i=0 through 7
numeric.arithmetic: None; exact bitwise storage without truncation or conversion.

verification.oracle: Original positive-edge DFF requirement, sampled after NBA settling.
verification.coverage: All 256 binary values, walking bit patterns, hold during high/low clock, falling-edge hold, repeated captures and four-state bit copying.
verification.timeout: Bounded testbench timeout with fatal failures and PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original gives no initialization or reset.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Leave uninitialized; no pre-first-edge defined-value requirement.
